title: Crash between integration merge and record save duplicated a consequential effect
summary: Found by the new kill-point (crash_after_merge) and invariant (each node merged into the integration branch at most once) in tests/test_orchestrator_state_machine.py: 4 violations in 40 seeds, nondeterministic (timing-dependent), reproduced on two seeds. After the crash the reloaded run record did not know the merge had landed; the node continued (for example through a repair round with new commits) and was merged again, so the integration branch carried changes from an attempt the record never accepted. Fixed in 6b3c9eaf (DEC-0019).
